tagline: I build and automate reliable Linux infrastructure, increasingly with AI agents in the loop. This page runs on it.
about_p1: I am a self-taught Linux and DevOps engineer based in Dortmund, deliberately returning to IT after a long logistics career. My first hands-on experience came at school, where I administered Linux game servers over SSH and FTP, maintained PHP forums and built HTML websites.
about_p2: Today I design, deploy and operate a production Raspberry Pi 5 homelab with Docker, monitoring, DNS, automation and AI services running around the clock. I am looking for a Junior DevOps or Linux Systems Administrator role and am available from January 2027.
